svg.title: EthosGPT: mapped sample, model update, signed survey gaps, and theory-weight sensitivity
svg.text: EthosGPT | Whose values guide technological change?
Survey representation → language-model update → possible innovation and adjustment
A Where are the sampled countries?
64 countries across eight descriptive cultural-region labels
Map marks use the region keys in B; locations are samples, not borders.
B What changed in eight regions?
bar = 95% CI; open = spans 0 or n < 5

g.text: C Which views differ from the survey?
Zero = survey; left less, right more of named view
D Does emphasis change the audit?
Weighted error: teal = lower for 5.6 Sol
